ideas.title: The Impact of Pandemic Fraud on Minnesota's Welfare System
ideas.description: Investigate the extent of pandemic-era welfare fraud in Minnesota, its effects on the state's welfare system, and the measures being taken to prevent future fraud.
ideas.angle: In-depth analysis of the Feeding Our Future case and its implications
questions: How widespread was pandemic-era welfare fraud in Minnesota?
What steps are being taken to prevent future fraud?
ideas.insight: This story could uncover patterns of fraud and potentially identify weaknesses in the welfare system that need to be addressed.
